subject.title: feat(cli): add `agents` and `<agent> models` runtime discovery commands

question: Should `acpx models` become a permanent command when live model metadata currently requires creating an ACP session, and if so, what lifecycle and output contract should it guarantee?
rationale: ACP exposes model metadata through session creation rather than a side-effect-free catalog call, while repository policy treats command keywords and output shapes as long-term compatibility surface; code review cannot choose that product contract safely.

options.title: Split and redesign models
options.body: Land the safe enumeration and Devin work only after documentation fixes, while holding `models` until its created session can be retained, closed, or otherwise managed explicitly.

options.title: Approve managed session creation
options.body: Keep `models`, but define the `session/new` side effect, retain or clean up the resulting session through a supported lifecycle, and add remote-agent proof plus stable schema documentation.

options.title: Accept untracked sessions
options.body: Ship the current probe semantics and explicitly document that model discovery may create provider-side sessions that acpx cannot subsequently manage.

recommendation.title: Split and redesign models
recommendation.body: Land the safe enumeration and Devin work only after documentation fixes, while holding `models` until its created session can be retained, closed, or otherwise managed explicitly.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent registry and convention history makes this the strongest available owner for approving a new durable CLI namespace and output contract.
